approval_basis: Delegated phase-orchestrator approval under AGENTS.md routine in-phase authorization for this exact state-pin release transition, applying adopted decisions D-113 and D-120.
decision: Advance the exact serialized state-release token from 0.2.1 to 0.3.0 while retaining format and behavior tokens at 1 and preserving the canonical fixture bytes. State loads require the exact GabbaBoy release; battery saves remain the cross-version persistence path.
rationale: The version bump changes state-load identity by design. The format and behavior tokens and all canonical fixture bytes remain unchanged, while a cross-version state load remains rejected.
affected_semantics: State-load identity is bound to exact release version.
Format and behavior compatibility tokens remain unchanged.
Battery saves remain the cross-version persistence path.

evidence.description: The completed Phase 17 snapshot-fork summary covers 198 serialized fields and 14 model-applicable in-flight categories; this release transition retains those state-format and behavior contracts while advancing only the exact release token.
